_comment: CREA — every client-specific name, path, key and preference lives here and NOWHERE else. Transplanting to Connell's Mac Mini means editing this file only.

paths._comment: Deliberately NOT in iCloud: launchd/cron jobs do not run reliably from an iCloud-synced folder.

brain._escalate_note: Set to a paid model id to let hard single steps borrow a stronger brain. Null = free only.
brain._routing_note: Hermes points at OmniRoute (localhost:20128/v1), an OpenAI-compatible router over free cloud models. Zero local RAM, zero cost. Swap LM_BASE_URL in ~/.hermes/.env to go local (ollama) or paid (Anthropic).

voice._comment: Free tier is the default and must work standalone. Paid is a drop-in swap of these two strings — no code change.

wake._note: Wake detection is fully on-device. No audio leaves the machine until the phrase fires.

integrations._status_note: status is a CLAIM until a call succeeds in-transcript. Never trust this field alone.

whatsapp._mode_note: baileys-personal pairs by QR like WhatsApp Web. Does NOT migrate the number to the Business Cloud API, so the consumer app and chat history survive. Unofficial client: small ban-risk on the number, disclose to principal.

call_recording._legal: NSW Surveillance Devices Act 2007 s7 requires all-party consent. Disclosure below is played/spoken at call start to establish consent before any audio is retained. Jurisdiction is config, not code — do not ship this to another state without review.
call_recording.disclosure_text: Just so you know, I record calls so I get the booking details right.
call_recording._retain_note: false = transcribe then discard audio. Keeps the retained artifact to the booking facts only.

media_pipeline._gap_note: A break longer than this between shot timestamps starts a new shoot.
media_pipeline._format_note: never | ask | auto. Ships as 'never'. The card is the only irreplaceable copy until Drive confirms; auto-format is how you lose a client's shoot.
